content:
If you're like me, you may have spent hours clicking around Wikipedia, randomly browsing articles. Now there's finally an official app—well, more of a widget—that lets you do just that.

Now there's finally a button that takes you directly to a random Wikipedia article.

Today's update to the Wikipedia iOS app adds a fun and useful new feature: a "Random Article" widget that can be placed on your iPhone and iPad home screens.

The widget comes in two sizes (large and medium) and features a cute mascot.

Tap the widget and you'll be taken to a completely random Wikipedia article, which will open in random mode.

No need to leave the app and tap the widget again—just hit the random button to dive deeper and deeper into this random maze, like rolling dice.

Have fun, but be careful not to lose track of time! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app also added a history trivia game.

After you update the Wikipedia iPhone and iPad app today, you'll be able to find this brand-new widget.

Make the most of your Apple devices!
